--- attachments/can_signal_notes.txt ---
Remote unlock bench notes
--------------------------

Capture interface: can1
Arbitration ID: 18FF50A5
DLC: 8

Payload layout:
  byte 0 : counter high
  byte 1 : counter low
  byte 2 : fixed phase marker
  byte 3 : rolling token byte 3
  byte 4 : rolling token byte 2
  byte 5 : rolling token byte 1
  byte 6 : rolling token byte 0
  byte 7 : XOR of byte 0 through byte 6

Accepted counters increase by one. Replays are rejected. All multi-byte
fields in the rolling token are big-endian.

Only the first eight accepted records were recovered.

--- attachments/field_service_extract.txt ---
Field service extract
---------------------

The rolling-token block is a 32-bit unsigned transform. The service sheet
removed all numeric constants because the bench technician must read them from
the rework photo.

  K     = R1..R4 nibble pairs
  S     = value printed in U1
  M     = R5..R8 nibble pairs
  R     = number of diode triangles
  N     = 16-bit counter, big-endian

  X = K xor (N * S)
  X = rotate_left(X, R)
  X = X xor M
  T = X xor (X >> 13)

Token bytes are transmitted in big-endian order.
Use the vendor colour/nibble card in the photo directory.
